content: Number of intervals in which a given conversion ap- plies CompuScales is a number of intervals (called CompuScale ) within which a certain conversion applies. The respective interval is given in terms of upper and lower limit. Within each CompuScale we have the abstract CompuScaleContents . To deal with possible ambiguities directly, an inverse value can be provided explicitly for that particular scale ( compuInverseValue ).
